title: Move a workspace from window 1 to window 2 and back: it shows in the window named, the window it left keeps its others
why: Lawrence 2026-10-28 (handoff/multiwindow.md): moving a workspace between windows must act on the two windows named and no other: the workspace shows in the target window, the window it left keeps showing what it showed (its panes, focused pane and frame) and lists it no more, and a third window does not change. The move runs the Move Workspace to Window action (moveWorkspaceToWindow, the sidebar row's Move to Window menu item and the palette entry) through action.run with the target workspace and an explicit `window` argument; typing in the target window then reaches the moved workspace's terminal.
